business_outcome: Ensuring that everyone in the company can deliver for customers at the peak of their ability is core to the technology team’s remit, and new tools like AI fit that goal. Frieman recommends open-mindedness as core to implementing successful tech initiatives.
metrics: Increased query speed and reliability of databases and saved costs with no slowdown during peak holiday shopping
Built a cloud environment now able to handle a 10x spike in volume, performance, and reliability

The first step was partnering with Google and the order management system app provider to identify what needed to be updated and decide how best to shift a decade of stored procedures and other detailed database application layer functions. To ensure seamless holiday shopping for all its customers, the team had to ensure that systems could handle at least a 10x spike in volume, performance, and reliability.

“This was the first year through the holidays we ran our order management through Google Cloud on AlloyDB, and it was flawless,” says Frieman. “Our goal is that systems like this should be boring even through the peak, and that’s what we got. We’re very pleased with how it performed during peak.”
URBN has seen continued improvement even after holiday shopping subsided. Some of the longest running queries are now outperforming in measurable speed now that they’re on AlloyDB.

“Having Gemini as an easily accessible and key component in our day-to-day workload has been really critical,” says Frieman. Beyond the collaboration capabilities, Workspace also provides URBN’s employees the ability to search Google Drive for years’ worth of valuable data.
architecture_clues: URBN relies on Google Cloud to power much of its infrastructure, and recently migrated critical workloads to AlloyDB, as well as adding Workspace and Gemini AI.
